name: Zoltán Kovács
bio:
Zoltán's fascination with engines began in his grandfather's workshop, where he spent countless hours disassembling and reassembling old motorcycles. This early exposure sparked a lifelong passion for mechanical engineering and a desire to understand the intricate workings of motorsport vehicles. After graduating from the Budapest University of Technology with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Zoltán honed his skills working in precision manufacturing before joining Reiza Racing Academy.

As a machinist, Zoltán is known for his meticulous attention to detail and unwavering commitment to quality. He approaches every task with a methodical precision, ensuring that each component meets the exacting standards required for high-performance racing. His ability to remain calm under pressure and his knack for identifying potential problems before they arise make him an invaluable asset to the team. Zoltán's dedication to his craft extends beyond the workshop; he is constantly seeking out new techniques and technologies to improve the performance and reliability of the team's machinery.

What sets Zoltán apart is his ability to blend old-world craftsmanship with modern engineering principles. He believes that a deep understanding of the fundamentals is crucial for innovation, and he constantly draws upon his knowledge of traditional machining methods to create cutting-edge solutions for the racetrack.
